semiconductor_relevance: High — Canaan Technology specializes in advanced modular equipment for semiconductor-grade photoresists and electronic chemicals, making it a relevant player in the semiconductor manufacturing process.
summary: Zhejiang Canaan Technology Limited designs and manufactures advanced modular equipment for semiconductor applications, particularly in the production of photoresists and electronic chemicals. Their solutions include fully automated production lines that meet stringent cleanroom standards, catering to the needs of semiconductor manufacturers.
capabilities: Automated modular production lines for semiconductor-grade photoresists
AI recipe control for real-time process adjustments

regional_presence.China: Canaan Technology has a significant manufacturing presence in Nanjing, with a production base spanning over 200 acres.
